The fixture reduces post-RETURN idle from 45,000 ms to 3,000 ms while forbidding pre-RETURN activation and keeping normal semantic-dedup/PIN/promotion authority intact.

PASS invalidation: artifact/version/digest mismatch yields STALE_PREPARATION and activate=false.
PASS expected-value gate: positive branch admitted; negative, duplicate, premature-authority and consumerless branches rejected.
